name: sotrics
description: Amazon seller analytics from Sotrics: sales, profit and P&L, product health checkup (SKU optimization), PPC campaigns and search terms, inventory and restock forecasts, keyword ranks, competitors and cash flow. Read only.

interface.longDescription:
Sotrics is an analytics platform for Amazon sellers and agencies. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about your Amazon business in plain language; answers come from your Sotrics data. Sales, profit, inventory and returns come from Seller Central; advertising numbers appear once your Amazon Ads account is connected (the sample account shows demo PPC data).

What you can ask:
- Sales and profit: headline numbers versus the previous period, a P&L by day, week, month or quarter, per-product profit, margin and ROI, trends, sales by region, returns and expenses.
- Product health checkup (SKU optimization): net revenue, CM1/CM2/CM3, FBA and Amazon fee percentages, return on capital, turnover and keep/fix/drop analysis per product.
- Advertising: PPC overview (spend, ad sales, ACOS, TACOS, ROAS), campaigns, customer search terms with wasted spend, PPC benchmarks and negative keywords.
- Inventory: stock and days of supply per SKU, restock forecast with stockout and reorder dates, purchase orders and cash flow.
- Market: keyword rank tracking, competitor prices and listing changes, Brand Analytics Search Query Performance and product research projects.

Read only: Sotrics never changes anything in your Sotrics account or on Amazon. Every answer uses the same calculations and permissions as the Sotrics web app, for each seller account your Sotrics login can open. Sign-in uses OAuth; your password and Amazon keys are never shared with ChatGPT.

Requires a Sotrics account (sotrics.com) that the Sotrics team has approved, with an Amazon seller account connected.
defaultPrompt: What were my Amazon sales, profit and margin last month vs the month before?
Which PPC search terms spent money with no orders in the last 30 days?
Which of my products will run out of stock first, and when should I reorder?

positive.description: Sales, profit and margin compared with the previous period
positive.prompt: What were my sales, profit and margin in the last 30 days compared with the 30 days before?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns sales, orders, units, Amazon fees, profit and margin for the last 30 days next to the previous period, for the default seller account, and says when the data is sample data.

positive.prompt: Show my Amazon P&L by week for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a weekly P&L with sales, refunds, Amazon fees, cost of goods, advertising, gross and net profit, margin and ROI, plus the total.

positive.prompt: Which PPC search terms spent money but got no orders in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists customer search terms with clicks and spend but zero orders, sorted by spend, with the campaign and ASIN they belong to.

positive.prompt: Which of my SKUs will run out of stock first, and when should I reorder the riskiest one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists SKUs by days of supply, then gives the stockout date, reorder date and suggested quantity for the riskiest ASIN.

positive.prompt: Run the product health checkup and tell me which products to keep, fix or drop.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns net revenue, contribution margins, fee percentages, return on capital and a combined rank per product, with keep, fix or drop suggestions and the reasons.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the ocean.

negative.description: Public stock market data, not seller data
negative.prompt: What is Amazon's stock price today?

negative.description: Write action the read-only app cannot do
negative.prompt: Raise the bid on my best PPC campaign by 20%.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 30 read-only Sotrics tools for Amazon sales, profit, PPC, inventory, rank tracking, competitors, research and cash flow, plus three guided workflows (P&L review, PPC search-term audit, restock planner).
